examples.label: Example 1
examples.display:
posts  = [[1, 7], [3, 7], [5, 8], [12, 8], [14, 8], [15, 9], [18, 7], [20, 9]]
window = 10
k      = 2
output = [9, 8]

T is 20. In the current window (after 10) tags 8 and 9 have two posts and tag 7 has one. In the previous window tag 7 had two and tag 8 one. Growth: tag 9 is +2, tag 8 is +1, tag 7 is −1.

examples.display:

Tag 1 went from two posts to one, so nothing is trending.
